title: Intelli Audit framework selection screen loads without console errors
steps: Log in as a seeded test org admin
expectedResult: Framework selection screen renders with activated frameworks listed, no unhandled console errors.

title: GET /qre-questions loads the strategic/tactical question set
steps: Call GET /api/intelligent-audit/qre-questions/strategic with a valid session
expectedResult: Returns 200 with a non-empty question set.

title: Creating a new intelligent audit via POST / succeeds for a valid framework selection
preconditions: At least one framework activated for the project
steps: POST /api/intelligent-audit/ with a valid frameworkId and project scope
expectedResult: Audit record is created (201) and Phase 1 becomes accessible.

title: Phase 1 progress endpoint loads for a newly created audit
steps: GET /api/intelligent-audit/:auditId/phase/1/progress for a freshly created audit
expectedResult: Returns 200 with progress at 0% and no server error, even with no sections completed yet.

title: My Assignments list loads for an auditor with no assignments yet
steps: GET /api/intelligent-audit/my-assignments as a freshly onboarded auditor
expectedResult: Returns 200 with an empty array, not an error.
